title: NAIS P0 Domain Events
description: Envelope + per-event payload. Owner: Agent 0. event_type suffix .vN is the payload version; breaking change => new version, old one kept for one release.

oneOf.title: identity.organization.created.v1
oneOf.description: Organization registered.

oneOf.title: identity.user.created.v1
oneOf.description: User provisioned from first OIDC login or seed.

oneOf.title: identity.user.logged_in.v1
oneOf.description: First authenticated request of a session (Audit LOGIN).

oneOf.title: identity.membership.changed.v1
oneOf.description: Organization membership roles or status changed (Audit ADMIN_ROLE_CHANGED).

oneOf.title: project.created.v1
oneOf.description: Project created.

oneOf.title: project.archived.v1
oneOf.description: Project archived.

oneOf.title: project.member.added.v1
oneOf.description: Member added (P0 direct add; also triggers invitation notification).

oneOf.title: project.member.removed.v1
oneOf.description: Member removed. Governance revokes that user's grants scoped to the project.

oneOf.title: project.member.role_changed.v1
oneOf.description: Member project role changed.

oneOf.title: catalog.dataset.created.v1
oneOf.description: Dataset created.

oneOf.title: catalog.dataset.access_level_changed.v1
oneOf.description: Access level changed (Audit POLICY_CHANGED).

oneOf.title: catalog.dataset.policy_changed.v1
oneOf.description: allowed_purposes / approval_required / max_grant_days changed (Audit POLICY_CHANGED).

oneOf.title: catalog.dataset.version_published.v1
oneOf.description: Version published and now immutable. Readiness auto-queues default profile.

oneOf.title: governance.access.requested.v1
oneOf.description: Access request submitted or resubmitted.

oneOf.title: governance.access.review_started.v1
oneOf.description: Reviewer started review (SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW, D-025).

oneOf.title: governance.access.approved.v1
oneOf.description: Request approved; grant created ACTIVE.

oneOf.title: governance.access.rejected.v1
oneOf.description: Request rejected.

oneOf.title: governance.access.changes_requested.v1
oneOf.description: Reviewer asked requester to change the request.

oneOf.title: governance.access.withdrawn.v1
oneOf.description: Requester withdrew the request.

oneOf.title: governance.access.revoked.v1
oneOf.description: Grant revoked by steward, org admin, or system (project member removed / project archived / membership disabled).

oneOf.title: governance.access.expiring_soon.v1
oneOf.description: Emitted once per grant 72h before expires_at.

oneOf.title: governance.access.expired.v1
oneOf.description: Sweeper marked grant EXPIRED. Enforcement does not depend on this event.

oneOf.title: governance.download.authorized.v1
oneOf.description: Signed download URLs issued (Audit FILE_DOWNLOADED).

oneOf.title: governance.download.denied.v1
oneOf.description: Download session denied (security monitoring).

oneOf.title: readiness.validation.started.v1
oneOf.description: Validation run moved to RUNNING.

oneOf.title: readiness.validation.completed.v1
oneOf.description: Validation run finished (run_status COMPLETED or FAILED).

oneOf.title: identity.user.updated.v1
oneOf.description: Self-service profile fields changed (e.g. NTIS researcher number).

oneOf.title: catalog.dataset.metadata_changed.v1
oneOf.description: Non-policy dataset metadata or contributors changed (Audit DATASET_UPDATED; M11 index input).

oneOf.title: workspace.input.added.v1
oneOf.description: Dataset version pinned as a project input (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_ADDED; notes evidence INPUT_ADDED; hub most_used).

oneOf.title: workspace.input.version_changed.v1
oneOf.description: Pinned input version changed explicitly (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_VERSION_CHANGED; notes evidence INPUT_VERSION_CHANGED).

oneOf.title: workspace.input.removed.v1
oneOf.description: Project input removed (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_REMOVED).

oneOf.title: workspace.recipe.saved.v1
oneOf.description: Recipe created or saved as a new version (Audit RECIPE_SAVED; notes evidence RECIPE_SAVED).

oneOf.title: workspace.run.succeeded.v1
oneOf.description: Recipe run finished and produced a DERIVED_DATASET output (Audit RUN_SUCCEEDED; notes evidence RUN_SUCCEEDED).

oneOf.title: workspace.run.failed.v1
oneOf.description: Recipe run failed; error is a short summary without data values (Audit RUN_FAILED; notes evidence RUN_FAILED).

oneOf.title: workspace.output.created.v1
oneOf.description: Output created from a run or an upload (Audit OUTPUT_CREATED; notes evidence OUTPUT_CREATED).

oneOf.title: workspace.publish.requested.v1
oneOf.description: Hub publication of an output requested; one approval slot per organization (Audit OUTPUT_PUBLISH_REQUESTED; notifies the organizations' DATA_STEWARDs; notes evidence PUBLISH_REQUESTED).

oneOf.title: workspace.publish.decided.v1
oneOf.description: One organization decided a publish request; request_status is the request status after this decision (Audit OUTPUT_PUBLISH_DECIDED; notifies the requester). A terminal catalog publication failure is reported as a system REJECT (request_status REJECTED) with failure_reason.

oneOf.title: workspace.comment.added.v1
oneOf.description: Comment added (first comment of a new thread included). project_id is null for DATASET threads and required (non-null) for PROJECT/OUTPUT/RECIPE threads (Audit COMMENT_ADDED; DATASET threads notify the owner organization's DATA_STEWARDs).

oneOf.title: notes.note.submitted.v1
oneOf.description: Research note submitted and locked (Audit NOTE_SUBMITTED; notifies witnesses).

oneOf.title: notes.note.signed.v1
oneOf.description: A signature was recorded; final=true when the note became SIGNED (Audit NOTE_SIGNED; notifies the recorder when a witness signs).

oneOf.title: notes.note.rejected.v1
oneOf.description: Witness returned a submitted note to DRAFT with a reason (Audit NOTE_REJECTED; notifies the recorder).

oneOf.title: notes.note.viewed.v1
oneOf.description: Someone other than the recorder opened the note (Audit NOTE_VIEWED, 열람 관리대장).
